title: Director transition announcement + Q&A scratchpad
body:
Purpose: scratchpad for drafting the internal announcement and Q&A for Director of Product transition. Keep rough — will iterate with execs + legal.

Context notes to self:
- Director (Samira Patel) is stepping down to pursue a startup; last day 2026-03-31. Voluntary; leaving on good terms.
- Interim: Marcus Lee (VP Product) will cover day-to-day responsibilities; hiring process for permanent director to begin immediately.
- Sensitive: compensation/handover details handled offline with managers. Do not include numbers in public note.
- Keep message short, human, values-first. Link to FAQ and invite to live Q&A.

Timeline (rough):
- Draft announcement to execs: 2026-03-09 (today)
- Finalize with CEO + People Ops sign-off: 2026-03-12
- Send company-wide note: 2026-03-16 (avoid end-of-week spam)
- Live Q&A session (townhall-style): 2026-03-18 11am PT

Audience segmentation: all-employees (company-wide) + product org follow-up + managers only notes (handover expectations).

Draft company note (very rough):
"Hi team — I want to share that Samira Patel will be stepping down from her role as Director of Product at the end of March to pursue an exciting founder opportunity. Samira has been part of Redwood for 4.5 years and contributed to key launches around Dedicated and the Optimize playbook. We’re grateful for her leadership and wish her the best. Marcus Lee will act as interim director while we begin an external search to find the next leader. We’ll hold a short Q&A on March 18 to answer questions; please add any questions to the FAQ doc in Confluence. More context and next steps below.

We recognize transitions can raise questions about roadmap and stability — leadership is committed to continuity and a clear hiring timeline. If you have concerns, talk to your manager or reach out to people-ops@redwood.com.

— CEO (placeholder)"

(Flag: tone needs CEO voice; don't publish this verbatim.)

FAQ / likely Qs to prepare answers for:
- Why is Samira leaving? (short positive phrasing. emphasize mutual support and future plans.)
- Will product roadmap change? (no immediate changes; commitments maintained; Marcus + PM leads will share plan.)
- Will there be layoffs / org restructuring? (No — this is a leadership change only.)
- How long will the interim last? (Expect 3–6 months; we’ll update.)
- Who is handling hiring? (People Ops + Recruiting + VP Product owning process.)
- Can I apply for director role? (Yes; internal candidates encouraged. Details in hiring doc.)
- Customer signals? (We’ll coordinate customer comms for key accounts; account teams notified separately.)

Talking points for Marcus (interim):
- Acknowledge Samira’s contribution quickly.
- Focus on continuity: what stays same (roadmap, timelines) and what we’ll double-check (OKRs, headcount requests).
- Commit to weekly office hours for product org for first month.
- Encourage questions and feedback; point to Confluence FAQ.

Manager guidance (short note to managers to attach to announcement):
- Hold team huddles in 48 hours after announcement.
- Reiterate roadmap priorities to reports.
- Escalate compensation/handover concerns to people-ops inbox.
- Collect top-3 risks from each manager by 2026-03-20.

Communications checklist (TODO):
- [ ] CEO finalize 2-line opener
- [ ] Legal review for language about role/hiring
- [ ] Create Confluence FAQ page + allow comments
- [ ] Schedule townhall + calendar invite + recording
- [ ] Draft manager note + manager Slack pings
- [ ] Update org chart (internal) and ownership matrix
- [ ] Notify top 10 customers (prepare joint statement with Sales)
- [ ] Set up internal hiring job req, post externally

Slack post draft (short):
"Hey everyone — quick update: Samira is leaving Redwood at the end of March. We’re grateful for her leadership. Marcus will serve as interim; we’ll share a company note and hold a Q&A on March 18. Link to FAQ: <confluence link>."

Rehearsal notes (for CEO / Marcus):
- Keep it under 60s in live announcement.
- Use names and specifics (product areas Samira led).
- Avoid speculation about reasons beyond what Samira shared.
- Pause after 'interim' line and invite Qs.

Open questions / hard edges:
- Should we include an internal thank-you gift / card? (People Ops budget?)
- Will Samira be allowed to join as advisor/consultant post-departure? (depends on non-compete; legal check.)
- Who will pick up on critical on-call/product incidents? (Runbook update needed.)

Notes to self: do quick sync with Rajiv (recruiting) and Leah (legal) before finalizing. Keep language short, don’t overpromise.

Version history:
- v0.1 2026-02-15 initial scratch
- v0.5 2026-03-09 updated timeline + rehearsal notes (current)
speaking_points: Thank Samira and name two concrete wins (Dedicated launch, Optimize toolkit).
Reassure continuity: roadmap and commitments unchanged.
Announce interim (Marcus Lee) and hiring plan timeline (3-6 months).
Invite questions at townhall + link to FAQ.
quick_todos: Confirm townhall time with calendar team
Make Confluence FAQ editable for comments
